name: Gentle Luminance
description: Let a soft radiance spread from the palm over an ally's wound so the flesh settles and the pain thins.

name: Pulse Easing
description: Ease the pulse of an ally breathless from a long run with slow even beats of warm qi.

name: Warmth Tracing
description: Read the warmth beneath an ally's skin to find where the blood runs thin or cold.

name: Venom Coaxing
description: Coax a slow venom out of an ally's blood with patient pulls of clean qi.

name: Layered Balm
description: Smooth layer upon layer of healing balm over a deep wound of an ally until it is whole.

name: Jolting Fist
description: Jolt the target's ribs with a fist that carries a surge of vitality deep into the body.

name: Pulse Awakening
description: Awaken the stilled pulse of an ally by pressing three fingers to the chest and beating vitality into it.

name: Springing Barrier
description: Raise a springing barrier of vitality that returns the force of each blow with a shiver.

name: Piercing Stream
description: Drive a narrow piercing stream of vitality through shield and armour into the flesh behind.

name: Bountiful Palm
description: Pour the whole school's gathered vitality through one palm into a gravely wounded ally and close wounds that would kill.

name: Coolpalm
description: Lay a cooling hand on an ally's inflamed wound to draw the heat and start the closing.

name: Steadfast Gift
description: Give an ally a steadfast gift of vitality that keeps the heart from faltering under strain.

name: Dart Step
description: Dart in a short quick line on bursts of vitality to arrive at a wounded ally's side.

name: Taint Easing
description: Ease a clinging taint out of an ally's veins with a slow gentle current of qi.

name: Pulse Weave
description: Weave the rhythm of an ally's pulse back into an even beat while the torn tissue about it closes.

name: Veilsweep
description: Turn aside a blow with a swirling veil of vitality that carries its force past the body.

name: Pulse Hammer
description: Hammer the target's chest with a fist timed to its own heartbeat so the blow lands doubled.

name: Throb Recall
description: Recall a failing heart to its throb by matching its last faint beats with pulses of vitality.

name: Pulse Wave
description: Send a wave of vitality rolling out from the chest to throw enemies off their feet.

name: Hushing Tide
description: Hush the pain of a whole group with a slow tide of vitality that settles every wound it passes.

name: Breathcrown
description: Crown a fallen ally with the full vitality of the school to bring breath and heartbeat back within the short window.

name: Silken Balm
description: Smooth a silken balm of qi across an ally's raw skin until the sting fades into warmth.

name: Lullhand
description: Lull the racing breath and shaking hands of a frightened wounded ally with a soft touch of qi.

name: Willing Vigor
description: Draw out an ally's own willing vigor and fan it until the ally rises ready to fight.

name: Poison Unspooling
description: Unspool a poison thread by thread from an ally's blood with delicate pulls of clean qi.

name: Hex Easing
description: Ease a binding hex off an ally's limbs with a gentle cleansing stroke from shoulder to fingertip.

name: Silken Ward
description: Spin a silken ward of vitality about the body that softens a heavy hit into a push.

name: Hushblow
description: Hush the target's breath with a quick strike to the throat that cuts its spoken or silent focus.

name: Breath Recovery
description: Recover a lost breath for an ally with long sealed-mouth exhales that carry the school's vitality into the lungs.

name: Silver Lance
description: Throw a silver lance of vitality from the fingertips that pierces cloth and mail to the flesh.

name: Azure Recall
description: Cast the school's recall over a fallen ally to draw the breath back into the lungs within the short window.

name: Verdant Blessing
description: Bestow the school's verdant blessing on a wounded ally so even grave injuries close in a long slow glow.

name: Extended Balm
description: Extend a balm of qi across a short gap to soothe the scrapes of a nearby ally.

name: Knitting Salve
description: Hold the field of qi steady about the body so every ally inside slowly knits their small wounds.

name: Reach Sensing
description: Spread the field of qi wide and sense the weak and failing pulses within its reach.

name: Radiant Slap
description: Slap the open palm to the target's cheek with a flash of vitality that stuns and dazzles.

name: Scouring Pulse
description: Purge poison and foul taint from every ally in the field with a pulse of clean qi.

name: Boundless Knit
description: Knit deep wounds on several allies at once with fine threads of qi spread through the field.

name: Fieldturn
description: Turn the whole field of qi like a wheel to swing a heavy blow wide of the body.

name: Gleaming Needle
description: Fling a gleaming needle of vitality from the field into the weak seam of the target's armour.

name: Wide Recall
description: Cast the field wide over a fallen ally and call the stopped heart back into its rhythm.

name: Taint Dissolve
description: Dissolve any poison or taint that enters the field before it reaches a single ally.

name: Boundless Restoration
description: Restore the wounded across the whole field with a slow wave of vitality that reaches every corner of it.

name: Resurgent Pulse
description: Send the school's resurgent pulse across the field to restart the stopped hearts of the fallen within the short window.

name: First Warmth
description: Bring the first warmth of the Core into the palm and press it over an ally's cut to close it.

name: Primal Vigor
description: Pass the Core's primal vigor to an ally across a held hand so strength and breath come back.

name: Coreshell
description: Draw a ward of Core vitality around the chest that blunts an arrow or a thrown stone.

name: Origin Purge
description: Purge a deep-set curse from an ally by washing the whole body in the Core's clear first vitality.

name: Birth Knit
description: Knit the worst wound of an ally as if it were newly made and had never been torn.

name: Coreblow
description: Throw a strike from the Core outward through the arm and into the target with crushing weight.

name: Heartbeat Origin
description: Give a stopped heart the origin beat from the Core and hold it until it carries on alone.

name: Radial Pulse
description: Pulse vitality radially from the Core to buffet every foe within arm's reach.

name: Firstbeat
description: Cast the first beat of life afresh into the lifeless within the short window and hold it steady.

name: Origin Bloom
description: Bloom the Core's origin vitality over the grievously hurt so that torn flesh and bone begin anew.

name: Staunch Warmth
description: Lay a plain warm hand over an ally's cut and breathe qi into it until it stops bleeding.

name: Hand Knit
description: Knit a wound closed by hand with slow patient strokes of vitality over many breaths.

name: Ranging Step
description: Take a long ranging step on vitality-light legs to reach a wounded comrade far across the open.

name: Humour Wash
description: Wash the sour humours of fever and sickness from an ally with a flowing pass of clean qi.

name: Even Closing
description: Close a long wound of an ally evenly from end to end without a puckered seam.

name: Tireless Guard
description: Hold a tireless guard of vitality that refreshes itself with each blow it takes.

name: Pairblow
description: Strike with both palms in a pair so that the second lands on the ripple of the first.

name: Fallen Callback
description: Call a fallen comrade back by kneeling over the body and driving vitality into the chest in rhythm.

name: Constant Aegis
description: Raise a steadfast aegis of vitality over the wounded that holds as long as the user stands.

name: Great Purging
description: Purge every poison and curse from the allies about the user with one great cleansing sweep.

name: Tireless Grace
description: Spread the school's tireless grace over the wounded so that fatigue and injury both drain away.

name: Coarse Salve
description: Work a coarse salve of qi into the scrapes and blisters of a labouring ally.

name: Strain Lifting
description: Lift the strain from an ally's overworked muscles with firm rolling presses of warm qi.

name: Sworn Boost
description: Boost an ally's strength with a sworn burst of vitality that lasts through the next heavy task.

name: Hammer Palm
description: Hammer an open palm down on the target's guard with a thump of crushing vitality.

name: Bile Cleanse
description: Cleanse the sour sickness of spoiled food or bile from an ally with a flowing pass of qi.

name: Sting Rinse
description: Rinse the venom of a stinging beast from an ally's swollen limb with repeated bright waves.

name: Sheet Warmth
description: Draw sheet after sheet of warmth over an ally's wound until deep and shallow harms both close.

name: Glancing Hide
description: Let the vitality-slick hide turn a hard swing so it glances off the shoulder.

name: Vowbreathing
description: Breathe the healer's pledge into a lifeless comrade in long steady breaths until the chest stirs.

name: Awl Surge
description: Thrust an awl of vitality through the armour at a joint and into the muscle beneath.

name: Spreading Renewal
description: Pour renewal over a working crowd so every hurt person in it feels the ache melt away.

name: Unflagging Return
description: Return the fallen from the edge of death with the school's unflagging surge inside the short window.

name: Pledge Salve
description: Rub a pledged salve of qi into an ally's wound and promise it will heal.

name: Wound Surveying
description: Survey every wound on an ally with a sweep of qi and name the worst of them first.

name: Steady Aegis
description: Hold a plain aegis of vitality up before an ally to take one hard blow.

name: Dross Drawing
description: Draw the dross of a dirty wound out of an ally before it can breed fever.

name: Pledged Knit
description: Knit a grave wound in an ally with threads of qi that the healer has pledged to see complete.

name: Oathbound Fist
description: Throw an oathbound fist that carries the weight of a vow into the target's guard.

name: Last Pledge
description: Make a last pledge over a dying comrade and pour vitality into the failing body to hold it.

name: Dulling Grip
description: Grip the target's forearm and dull its qi and strength as long as the clasp is held.

name: Vowneedle
description: Drive an oath needle of vitality into a nerve seat that drops the target's whole arm.

name: Oathbound Mercy
description: Grant the school's oathbound mercy to the gravely hurt so that wounds close and breath comes steady.

name: Drawn Warmth
description: Draw warmth from the wide field into the palm and lay it on an ally's chilled wound.

name: Long Soothing
description: Soothe an ally's aching body in one long unbroken stroke from head to heel.

name: Surging Gift
description: Gift an ally a surging flow of vitality drawn from the wide field.

name: Fieldrinse
description: Wash a swallowed poison or a foul taint from several allies at once through the shared field.

name: Broad Knit
description: Knit the wounds of a small group together in one broad weaving of qi.

name: Numbing Jolt
description: Jolt the target's elbow with a numbing pulse that drops the weapon from its hand.

name: Stout Veil
description: Hang a stout veil of vitality before the group that thins the force of every blow.

name: Pulse Rescue
description: Rescue a failing pulse by drawing life from the field and pressing it into the chest.

name: Bursting Ring
description: Burst the held field of qi outward in a ring that shoves back all enemies near.

name: Grand Recall
description: Cast a great recall through the field to pull several fallen back before the window shuts.

name: Greathand Renewal
description: Lay the great hand of the school on the field and renew every ally within it at once.

name: Primordial Warmth
description: Bring primordial warmth up from the Core into an ally's wound until it is clean and closed.

name: Quiet Closing
description: Close a wound quietly from within without disturbing the sleep of an exhausted ally.

name: Origin Sounding
description: Sound the origin of an ally's hurt and read whether it lies in flesh or in qi.

name: Base Vigor
description: Raise an ally's base vigor from the ground of the body upward with the Core's steady output.

name: Deep Purge
description: Purge the deepest roots of a poison from an ally's organs with the Core's clean current.

name: Marrow Purge
description: Purge a lingering curse from the marrow of an ally with a slow burning wash.

name: Sealing Warmth
description: Seal a gaping wound of an ally with a layer of warmth that sets like fresh skin.

name: Core Fist
description: Hurl a fist from the Core outward that lands with the full weight of stored vitality.

name: Source Return
description: Return a fallen ally to the source of life by passing the Core's vitality through the chest.

name: Lifecycle Rite
description: Run a rite of cleansing and mending and warding in a single cycle over the wounded.

name: Renascent Beat
description: Cast a renascent beat into the lifeless to start the heart anew within the short window.

name: Lifebloom Return
description: Return the dead-on-the-edge to life with the school's lifebloom and a full bloom of the Core's vitality in one breath.
